# Damage conversions

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** conversion, damage-pool

## Derived / confirmed formula

Priority chain `physical → lightning → cold → fire → erosion`; conversion flows UP only. A converted/added slice carries its PATH: type-specific increases SUM over the path, type-specific additionals MULTIPLY over the path; generic inc/add apply once. `convert` reduces the source's staying portion; `adds-as` is extra. >100% convert from one source caps at 100% and redistributes by weight.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. General outgoing-hit conversion system (cascade math + fraction handling). Core-talent line impls remain.

## Implementation (engine model)

`offense.py::_conversion_fracs` reads `<src>_convert_to_<dst>` and `<src>_as_<dst>` fractions (up-chain pairs only), caps total convert per source ≤1.0 (redistribute by weight), and expands `physical_as_elemental` into fire/cold/lightning adds-as. `_apply_conversion` cascades post-effectiveness flat `{type:(min,max)}` through `_CONV_PRIORITY`: each packet accumulates the UNION of dtype-tags of every type it has been; `convert` routes a slice down-chain and reduces `stay`, `adds-as` appends an extra slice leaving `stay` unchanged. At finalization a landing packet is scaled by `(1 + generic_inc + path_inc(path_tags)) × generic_add × path_add(path_tags)` — each type-specific modifier counted ONCE over the path union (so 'increased Elemental Damage' doesn't double-apply across an elemental→elemental hop). `path_inc` (`_path_spec_inc`) sums, `path_add` (`_path_spec_add`) is a `_additional_product`. No conversion → reproduces native `(1+type_inc)×type_add` per type (regression-safe). Ordered before enemy-vuln, above-max, Lucky.
